description: Release 7.9.3 & 7.9.4 — iCal (.ics) Calendar Attachment in Registration Confirmation Email (GQL-HF6) and Cup-Match Competitor Number Sync Hardening (GQL-HF5)

userStories.title: Build RFC 5545 iCal (.ics) generator and attach to sendRegistrationConfirmation in lib/email.js
userStories.description: As a registered shooter, I want an RFC 5545 .ics calendar invite attached to my registration confirmation email so I can add the Cup event to iPhone, Android, Outlook, or Google Calendar with one tap.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement buildRegistrationIcs({ cupId, cupName, starts, ends, shooterEmail, matchSquads }) in scoring-proxy/lib/email.js producing a valid RFC 5545 VCALENDAR/VEVENT (METHOD:REQUEST, deterministic UID registration-{cupId}-{shooterEmail}@ssi-tools, DTSTART, DTEND defaulting to starts + 8h when ends is absent)

Update sendRegistrationConfirmation in scoring-proxy/lib/email.js to accept optional { cupId, starts, ends } and attach { filename: 'ilmoittautuminen.ics', content: base64, content_type: 'text/calendar; charset=utf-8; method=REQUEST' } when starts is valid (falling back gracefully with a warning if starts is missing)
Update CupDetail GraphQL query in POST /api/v1/register/submit (scoring-proxy/routes/registration.js) to fetch starts and ends and pass { cupId, starts, ends } to sendRegistrationConfirmation
Add unit tests in scoring-proxy/test/email-ical.test.js verifying RFC 5545 .ics output, 8h fallback when ends is missing, deterministic UID, and graceful fallback when starts is missing
Mark GQL-HF6 as Implemented in docs/requirements/requirements.md
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test)
userStories.notes: Implemented buildRegistrationIcs and .ics attachment in sendRegistrationConfirmation with unit tests in email-ical.test.js.

userStories.title: Add SSI participant number scraping and update helpers in lib/ssi-core/participants.js
userStories.description: As a developer, I want SSI participant number read and update helpers in participants.js so the proxy can inspect and synchronize competitor numbers between a Cup and its included matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Add ssiSetParticipantNumber(participantId, number, cookies, participantContentType = 93) in scoring-proxy/lib/ssi-core/participants.js (and re-export in client.js) that GETs /event/participant/{ct}/{id}/edit/, extracts form fields, overrides 'number', and POSTs the edit form
Add unit tests in scoring-proxy/test/ssi-core-scraping.test.js verifying ssiSetParticipantNumber form field extraction and POST payload
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test)

userStories.title: Implement CUP-canonical competitor number mismatch detection and sync in lib/services/cup-manage.js
userStories.description: As a cup manager, I want CUP participant numbers treated as canonical and automatically compared/synchronized across all included matches.
acceptanceCriteria: Add buildCompetitorNumberSyncPlan(cupEvent) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/cup-manage.js mapping CUP competitors (by first_name + last_name + email key) to included match competitors and returning a deterministic list of mismatches ({ shooterName, email, canonicalNumber, matchId, matchName, matchParticipantId, currentNumber })
Add syncCupCompetitorNumbers({ cupEvent, cookies }) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/cup-manage.js that applies ssiSetParticipantNumber for each mismatch and returns an idempotent audit summary
Expose POST /api/v1/manage/cup/:id/sync-numbers in scoring-proxy/routes/management.js (with auditMutation logging) and also include numberMismatchCount in GET /api/v1/manage/cup/:id
Add unit and route tests in scoring-proxy/test/cup-manage.test.js and scoring-proxy/test/management.test.js
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test)

userStories.title: Add competitor number sync button in ManagePage (#/manage) and update requirements & release notes
userStories.description: As a cup manager on #/manage, I want to see when match competitor numbers differ from CUP numbers and synchronize them with one click.
acceptanceCriteria: Add manageSyncNumbers(cupId) in scoring-ui/src/api.js and display a 'Synkronoi kilpailijanumerot' banner/button in SquaddingOverview.jsx when numberMismatchCount > 0
Add component test in scoring-ui/src/test/components.test.jsx
Mark GQL-HF5 as Implemented in docs/requirements/requirements.md and add Release 7.9.3 & 7.9.4 entries to docs/RELEASE-NOTES.md
scoring-proxy tests pass (npm test) and scoring-ui lint, build, and tests pass (npm run lint && npm run build && npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --pool=threads)
userStories.notes: Added manageSyncNumbers in api.js and Synkronoi kilpailijanumerot banner in SquaddingOverview.jsx.

userStories.title: Implement Cartridge/Ammo Inventory store, gun-to-ammo linking (defaultAmmoId), checkout deduction, and stocktake discrepancy in backend
userStories.description: As an administrator, I want backend service functions and REST endpoints for ammo inventory grouped by (make, model, caliber), linking each gun to an ammo inventory item (defaultAmmoId), automatic stock deduction when a loaner gun is checked out with cartridges, and physical stocktake discrepancy calculation.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement ammo inventory grouped by (make, model, caliber) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/gun-inventory-service.js: listAmmo(), addAmmoPurchase({ make, model, caliber, count, price, store, purchaseDate, purchasedBy }), and recordAmmoStocktake({ ammoId, actualCount, notes, performedBy }) computing discrepancy = actualCount - calculatedBefore and updating calculatedStock = actualCount
Support defaultAmmoId (and resolved ammoMake/ammoLabel) on guns in createGun and updateGun in gun-inventory-service.js so each gun can be linked to an ammo inventory item

Update checkoutGun() so it uses the gun's linked defaultAmmoId (or an explicit ammoId override) when cartridgesGiven > 0, deducting cartridgesGiven from that ammo item's calculatedStock and incrementing totalIssued, and recording ammoId/ammoLabel on currentCheckout and usageHistory

Expose GET /api/v1/guns/ammo, POST /api/v1/guns/ammo/purchases, and POST /api/v1/guns/ammo/:id/stocktake in scoring-proxy/routes/guns.js (protected by the same SSI Group 25874 admin middleware as gun inventory, and include ammo list in GET /api/v1/guns)

Add unit and route tests in scoring-proxy/test/gun-inventory.test.js covering gun-to-ammo linking (defaultAmmoId), ammo purchase, checkout deduction, stocktake discrepancy calculation, and Group 25874 admin access enforcement on ammo endpoints
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test)
userStories.notes: Implemented ammo-inventory-service.js, gun-to-ammo linking (defaultAmmoId), checkout deduction, stocktake discrepancy, and CSV builders/endpoints.

userStories.title: Add Cartridge/Ammo Inventory, Gun-to-Ammo selector, Purchase Modal, and Stocktake Discrepancy UI to GunsPage (#/guns) and LoanerGunPickerSheet
userStories.description: As a club equipment manager, I want to select which ammo inventory item is used with each gun in #/guns, manage ammo purchases, perform physical ammo stocktakes with discrepancy display, and automatically pre-select the gun's linked ammo when handing over a loaner gun on #/manage.
acceptanceCriteria: Add getAmmo, addAmmoPurchase, and recordAmmoStocktake in scoring-ui/src/guns-api.js

Update GunsPage.jsx (#/guns) to include: (a) a 'Käytettävä patruuna (Linked Ammo)' dropdown in the Gun Add/Edit modal populated from the Ammo Inventory items (make + model + caliber) and displayed on each gun card, (b) a Patruunavarasto (Ammo Inventory) section showing each (make, model, caliber) with calculatedStock, totalPurchased, totalIssued, and last stocktake discrepancy, (c) '+ Lisää patruunaosto' modal (make, model, caliber, count, price, store, date, buyer), and (d) 'Inventointi' modal (actualCount -> shows live discrepancy vs calculatedStock)

Update LoanerGunPickerSheet.jsx and SquadCard.jsx to automatically pre-select and display the selected gun's linked ammo item (e.g. 'Patruuna: GCI FMJ 124gr (9x19)') and deduct from that ammo item on checkout
Add component tests in scoring-ui/src/test/components.test.jsx
scoring-proxy tests pass (npm test) and scoring-ui lint, build, and tests pass (npm run lint && npm run build && npm test -- --maxWorkers=1 --pool=threads)
userStories.notes: Added AmmoInventorySection.jsx, gun-to-ammo selector in GunsPage.jsx, and recommended ammo display in LoanerGunPickerSheet.jsx.

Add CSV download buttons ('Lataa aseet CSV', 'Lataa asetapahtumat CSV', 'Lataa patruunat CSV', 'Lataa patruunatapahtumat CSV') to GunsPage.jsx (#/guns)

userStories.title: Add undo gun & ammo loan (undoCheckoutGun) in backend and ManagePage (#/manage)
userStories.description: As a range officer in #/manage, I want to undo an active gun and ammo loan if a shooter leaves before shooting or if the wrong gun/ammo was selected, returning the gun to the safe and restoring the ammo stock and gun usage counters.
acceptanceCriteria: Implement undoCheckoutGun({ gunId, undoneBy }) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/gun-inventory-service.js: return gun to 'in_gun_safe', decrement timesUsedTotal (-1), timesUsedSinceMaintenance (-1), cartridgesIssuedTotal (-cartridgesGiven), and cartridgesSinceMaintenance (-cartridgesGiven) (clamped at 0), restore cartridgesGiven to the linked ammo item's calculatedStock (+cartridgesGiven) and decrement totalIssued (-cartridgesGiven), and mark the usageHistory entry as undone (undone: true, undoneAt, undoneBy)
Expose POST /api/v1/guns/:id/undo-checkout in scoring-proxy/routes/guns.js (with auditMutation logging) and add undoCheckoutGun(gunId) in scoring-ui/src/guns-api.js
Add a 'Peru lainaus' (Undo loan) button next to 'Palauta kaappiin' on checked-out shooters in SquadCard.jsx and wire it in SquaddingOverview.jsx
Add unit and route tests in scoring-proxy/test/gun-inventory.test.js and mark GUN19 / R90-GUN19 as Implemented in docs/requirements/requirements.md and docs/requirements/release-9.0-gun-inventory.md
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test) and scoring-ui lint and build pass (npm run lint && npm run build)
userStories.notes: Implemented undoCheckoutGun in gun-inventory-service.js, POST /api/v1/guns/:id/undo-checkout, and Peru lainaus button in SquadCard.jsx.

userStories.title: Record shooter ammo consumption events in ammo-inventory.json and gun maintenance count in gun-inventory.json
userStories.description: As an administrator and reporting analyst, I want gun events stored in gun-inventory.json (tracking total rounds, rounds since maintenance, and total maintenances) and ammo consumption events (who consumed cartridges, when, how many, in which cup/gun) stored in ammo-inventory.json and exported in ammo-events.csv so both gun-centric and ammo-per-shooter reports can be generated from their respective stores.
acceptanceCriteria: Include maintenanceCount (maintenanceHistory.length) on gun records and in buildGunsCsv() in scoring-proxy/lib/services/ammo-inventory-service.js

Record a consumption event in ammoItem.consumptions[] inside ammo-inventory.json whenever checkoutGun() issues cartridges (cartridgesGiven > 0), storing { id, checkoutId, timestamp, shooterName, shooterEmail, cupId, cupName, gunId, gunMake, gunModel, serialNumber, cartridgesConsumed, issuedBy, undone: false }
When undoCheckoutGun() is called, mark the matching ammoItem.consumptions[] entry as undone (undone: true, undoneAt, undoneBy) in ammo-inventory.json

Include 'consumption' rows (with shooterName, shooterEmail, cupName, gunMake/gunModel/serialNumber, count, timestamp, actor, undone status) in buildAmmoEventsCsv() so ammo-events.csv contains purchases, stocktakes, and per-shooter consumptions

Add unit tests in scoring-proxy/test/gun-inventory.test.js verifying ammoItem.consumptions[], undo marking, maintenanceCount, and CSV exports, and mark GUN20 / R90-GUN20 as Implemented in docs/requirements/
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test) and scoring-ui lint and build pass (npm run lint && npm run build)
userStories.notes: Recorded shooter consumption events in ammo-inventory.json consumptions[] and ammo-events.csv, and added maintenanceCount to guns.

userStories.title: Preserve full gun history on 'Poista' (Not in Use / Poistettu käytöstä state) with toggle in GunsPage
userStories.description: As an administrator, when I click 'Poista' on a gun in #/guns (e.g. when a gun is scrapped or sold), I want the gun marked as 'not in use' (Poistettu käytöstä) so it cannot be selected for shooting in #/manage while its full information, counters, and event history remain preserved in gun-inventory.json, CSV exports, and historical view.
acceptanceCriteria: Update retireGun(gunId, { reason, retiredBy }) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/gun-inventory-service.js and DELETE /api/v1/guns/:id in routes/guns.js to preserve the gun record and all usageHistory/maintenanceHistory, setting state = 'not_in_use' (and supporting legacy 'retired'), retiredAt, retiredBy, and retireReason

Ensure listGuns({ includeRetired: false }) excludes 'not_in_use' and 'retired' guns by default (so LoanerGunPickerSheet never shows them for shooting), while listGuns({ includeRetired: true }), buildGunsCsv(), and buildGunEventsCsv() always include them

Add a 'Näytä käytöstä poistetut' (Show not-in-use guns) checkbox toggle on GunsPage.jsx (#/guns) displaying 'Poistettu käytöstä' badge and retirement info while keeping all historical counters visible

Add unit tests in scoring-proxy/test/gun-inventory.test.js verifying that retiring a gun preserves its record and events in storage and CSV exports while excluding it from active loaner selection, and mark GUN22 / R90-GUN22 as Implemented
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test) and scoring-ui lint and build pass (npm run lint && npm run build)
userStories.notes: Updated retireGun to set state='not_in_use' preserving history and added Näytä käytöstä poistetut toggle on GunsPage.jsx.

userStories.title: Allow restoring gun from 'Poistettu käytöstä' to 'Asekaapissa' and replace gun modal ammo fields with single 'Suositeltu patruunamerkki ja malli' dropdown
userStories.description: As an administrator on #/guns, I want to restore a 'Poistettu käytöstä' gun back to 'Asekaapissa', and in the Gun Add/Edit modal I want a single 'Suositeltu patruunamerkki ja malli' dropdown populated from the ammo inventory (without stock numbers and without a duplicate 'Käytettävä patruuna varastosta' field).
acceptanceCriteria: Implement restoreGun(gunId) in scoring-proxy/lib/services/gun-inventory-service.js (transitioning 'not_in_use'/'retired' to 'in_gun_safe'), expose POST /api/v1/guns/:id/restore in scoring-proxy/routes/guns.js (with auditMutation), add restoreGun(gunId) in scoring-ui/src/guns-api.js, and render a 'Palauta asekaappiin' button on retired gun cards in GunsPage.jsx

In GunsPage.jsx Add/Edit modal, remove the 'Käytettävä patruuna varastosta' field and make 'Suositeltu patruunamerkki ja malli' a single <select> dropdown populated from ammo inventory items formatted as '{make} {model} ({caliber})' without showing stock count
Add unit and route tests in scoring-proxy/test/gun-inventory.test.js for restoreGun and mark GUN11, GUN23 / R90-GUN11, R90-GUN23 as Implemented in docs/requirements/
scoring-proxy lint and tests pass (npm run lint && npm test) and scoring-ui lint and build pass (npm run lint && npm run build)
userStories.notes: Implemented restoreGun (POST /api/v1/guns/:id/restore) with Palauta asekaappiin button and replaced gun modal ammo fields with single Suositeltu patruunamerkki ja malli dropdown.
